name: access-web
description: A web-based Microsoft Access look-alike with user accounts and .accdb export

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
